map.输入两相邻断面面积、断面间距、矿石体重与品位，用断面法（平行剖面法）计算体积与储: Enter two adjacent section areas, the section spacing, ore bulk density and grade to compute the volume and reserve by the cross-section (parallel section) method.
map.📖 查看「断面法储量估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Cross-Section Method Reserve Estimation Guide"
map.💡 公式：体积 V = (S₁+S₂)/2 × L；矿石量 Q = V × D；: 💡 Formula: volume V = (S₁+S₂)/2 × L; ore tonnage Q = V × D; metal content P = Q × C/100 (trapezoidal formula).
map.当 S₁/S₂ 接近1时用梯形法，差异大时可改用截锥公式: The trapezoidal method is used when S₁/S₂ is close to 1; when the difference is large the frustum formula may be used instead
map.断面应相互平行且垂直矿体走向: Sections should be parallel to each other and perpendicular to the ore-body strike
map.储量级别受工程控制程度影响，本工具仅计算体积量: The reserve category depends on the degree of engineering control; this tool only computes the volume
map.品位以%输入，贵金属 g/t 需先换算: Grade is entered in %; precious metals in g/t must be converted first
map.📚 深度解析：平行剖面（断面法）矿体储量估算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Parallel Section (Cross-Section) Ore-Body Reserve Estimation
map.两剖面间体积：已知相邻两勘探线断面面积与间距，求块段体积与矿石量: Volume between two sections: from the adjacent section areas and spacing, find the block volume and ore tonnage
map.边界外推：当一侧无工程控制时用楔形/锥形端角外推，结果须打折处理: Boundary extrapolation: when one side has no engineering control, use wedge/cone end-angle extrapolation and discount the result
map.金属量初算：叠加平均品位得金属量，辅助经济评价: Preliminary metal content: combine with the average grade to obtain the metal content, aiding economic evaluation
map.算法：平均断面 =（S₁+S₂）/2；体积 V = 平均断面 × 断面间距 L；: Algorithm: average section = (S₁+S₂)/2; volume V = average section × section spacing L; ore tonnage Q = V × bulk density D; metal content P = Q × grade C / 100. Suitable for layered or vein ore bodies of fairly stable attitude with a linear transition between the two sections (computed locally).
map.例：两平行断面 S₁=800 m²、S₂=600 m²、L=50 m、D=2.8: Example: two parallel sections S₁=800 m², S₂=600 m², L=50 m, D=2.8 t/m³, C=0.8% → average section=700 m², V=35000 m³, Q=98000 t (98,000 tonnes), P=784 t.
map.两断面形态差异很大时还可用吗？: Can it still be used when the two sections differ greatly in shape?
map.差异过大说明矿体形态变化剧烈，平均断面法误差增大。可改用块段法或地质统计学，并对: A large difference means the ore-body shape changes sharply and the average-section method becomes less accurate. The block method or geostatistics can be used instead, with the wedge-out/extrapolated ends treated separately.
map.品位缺失怎么办？: What if the grade is missing?
map.未填品位时金属量按 0 处理。正式估算应插值或取相邻工程品位，不应留空，否则会系: When the grade is left blank, the metal content is treated as 0. Formal estimation should interpolate or take the grade of adjacent workings; leaving it blank systematically underestimates the metal content.
map.采用平行断面法（梯形公式）估算矿体储量。输入两相邻勘探断面面积、断面间距、矿石体: Estimate ore-body reserves by the parallel section (trapezoidal) method. Enter two adjacent exploration section areas, the section spacing, ore bulk density and grade to compute the ore-body volume, ore tonnage and metal content; a common reserve calculation method in the exploration stage.
map.梯形法计算两断面间矿体体积: Trapezoidal method to compute the ore-body volume between two sections
map.同时输出矿石量与金属量: Outputs ore tonnage and metal content together
map.支持万吨单位换算: Supports conversion to units of 10,000 tonnes
map.纯前端计算，数据本地处理: Fully client-side computation; data processed locally
